title: SMM
subtitle: Company's own video content: video ideas, approval, shooting, editing and publishing
created: Idea created and sent for approval
approvedPartial: Your approval is saved. Waiting for the second one
monthHint: Month of publishing (or planned date, or creation)
kanbanHint: Drag a card to another stage. Shooting starts only after approval by the project manager and the CEO
hiddenOld: {count} older published and rejected — see the list or pick a month
emptyText: Create the first video idea — it will be sent for approval
scenarioHint: Plot, shots, voice-over, music — everything needed for the shoot
approvalHint: The idea is approved by the project manager (SMM) and the CEO. After both approvals it moves to “Approved”
revertHint: Only the CEO can revert a published video
leadVideoHint: The SMM specialist gets a bonus from the deal payments (commission rules)
dealVideoHint: If the client came from a video, the SMM specialist gets a bonus from each payment

statusHint.IDEA: Awaiting approval by the project manager and the CEO

errors.assigneeInvalid: The assignee must be an active executor with an SMM specialty
errors.approveOnlyIdea: Only an idea awaiting approval can be approved
errors.rejectOnlyIdea: Only an idea that is not in production yet can be rejected
errors.publishedRevertCeo: Only the CEO can revert a published video
errors.rejectWithReason: Use the “Reject” button and give a reason
errors.backToIdea: Only a rejected idea can go back to “Idea”
errors.needsApproval: The idea must first be approved by the project manager and the CEO
errors.usedInLeads: The video is used in leads or deals and cannot be deleted
errors.videoRequired: Choose the video the client came from
errors.videoNotPublished: Only a published video can be chosen
errors.videographerRequired: Select a videographer — without one the video cannot be moved to “Shooting”
errors.videographerInvalid: Only an active employee with the “Videographer” or “Mobilographer” specialty can be the videographer

notify.approved: Video idea approved — ready to shoot
notify.assigned: You are assigned to a video
notify.videographerAssigned: You are assigned as the videographer of a video

videographerHint: A videographer or mobilographer. Required for the “Shooting” stage; the published video counts for them too.
